_: THE REGISTER. Every Amenti name, and what kind of thing it is. Edit this file; register.html renders it. Public: no keys, emails or secrets here — those live on the bridge.
law: Each name is one kind of thing: company, product, repo, domain or address. A repo name is never a domain, and a domain is never a repo.
decision: One domain, amenti.live. Everything under one roof. Private parts on subdomains behind Cloudflare Access.

addresses.what: The Amenti Interface: Page1, the Hall, the Codex, Ask Amenti. Also /unsub, the VALL·HAL·LA unsubscribe page.
The Harbor and every fleet pane, this one included. Public on purpose: the newsletter and Page1 link to the Sonar, the Broadcast and the Ocean.
Redirects to amenti.live, path and query kept. Held until renewal.
Old addresses. GitHub sends them on to the new ones, so old links keep working.
The Amenti Studios website. Moving to studios.amenti.live with the paywall.
The productions' files: cue sheets, audio, art.
The Ingram Manor front door: "Where history talks back."

lessons: GitHub's redirect from an old github.io address carries no CORS header. A fetch() or web font that asks for the old address from another origin fails silently. Repoint first, then move.
Check what else an old address served before moving it. The unsubscribe page lived with the Hub and broke when the Hub moved.
Studios and Readings fetch names.csv and the voice bundle from the Interface. Repoint those before Studios moves.
